name: Angola

name: Benin
authority_name: Direction de l'Émigration et de l'Immigration (DEI)
evidence_title: DEI services and official Benin e-Visa
evidence_rationale: The official DEI site lists electronic and other visa services and residence-card services, while the Government of Benin e-Visa portal accepts visa applications.
research_notes: The originally researched Government of Benin URL https://evisa.gouv.bj/ redirected over HTTPS to https://evisa.bj. The official DEI website explicitly directs applicants to www.evisa.bj. Redirect reviewed and accepted.

name: Botswana
evidence_title: Botswana visa applications and e-Visa services
evidence_rationale: Botswana's government portal identifies the Department of Immigration and Citizenship and publishes visa application services, including online e-Visa access.
research_notes: Legacy government pages use more than one ministry label. Certify the Department first and require human confirmation of the current parent ministry.

name: British Indian Ocean Territory
evidence_title: Visa requirements — British Indian Ocean Territory
evidence_rationale: The official BIOT Administration states that no visa is required but prior approval is mandatory, with permits required for visiting yachts and restricted access to the Territory.
research_notes: Proposed as shared with GB because BIOT entry rules are administered by the Territory under UK overseas-territory governance. Legal and sovereignty status is sensitive and must receive specialist review before submission.

name: Burkina Faso
authority_name: Ministry of Security / Directorate General of National Police — Migration Division
evidence_rationale: The official Visa Burkina site is operated by the Ministry of Security and Directorate General of National Police, and publishes entry conditions and online visa procedures.
research_notes: The source identifies the Migration Division and provides official eVisa workflow. Keep the first assertion limited to services and visa-entry information visible in the captured snapshot.

name: Burundi
authority_name: Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Regional Integration and Development Cooperation
evidence_title: Visa application forms — Ministry of Foreign Affairs
evidence_rationale: The official Burundi Ministry of Foreign Affairs site publishes visa application forms and visa-service categories.
research_notes: Official source, but the wider site has content-hygiene concerns. Use a narrowly captured visa page, inspect the snapshot carefully and reject unrelated page content.

name: Cabo Verde
authority_name: Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Cooperation and Regional Integration — Consular Services
evidence_rationale: The official consular portal describes visa exemptions, visa types, application channels, residence visas and pre-registration requirements.
research_notes: Visa rules changed for some nationalities from January 2026. Capture a fresh immutable snapshot and avoid broad statements beyond the exact current page.

name: Cameroon
evidence_rationale: The official Ministry of External Relations site provides the e-Visa service, and the Republic of Cameroon consular portal accepts visa applications.
research_notes: The transactional portal is dynamic. Use the MINREX e-Visa information page as evidence and probe evisacam.cm separately before monitoring.

name: Central African Republic

official_source_name: Central African Republic short-stay visa service
